appointments.reply: Select My Appointments from the left sidebar of your Patient Portal to review your appointments. This assistant cannot retrieve your personal appointment details yet.
appointments.booking_reply:
To schedule a new appointment:
1. Select Find Doctors in the left sidebar.
2. Choose a doctor.
3. Select an available appointment slot.
4. Confirm your booking.
5. Open My Appointments to review it.

I can guide you through booking, but I won't make a reservation without your confirmation.

medical_records.reply: Select Medical Records from the left sidebar to view your available records. This assistant cannot interpret or provide medical advice about the contents of those records.

clinical_notes.reply: You can view clinical notes only when they have been released to your patient account. If you cannot find a released note, contact hospital support.
